text: Q: Who is Nutekh? A: Nutekh is a digital transformation agency based in Kigali, Rwanda, serving businesses across East Africa. We help teams deploy, integrate, and scale practical systems for online presence, operations, marketing, and payments.

Q: What does Nutekh do? A: Nutekh covers four areas: Presence (website and verified Google/social profiles), Automate (invoicing, stock checks, approvals, reminders), Market (positioning, creative, WhatsApp lead flow), and Connect (POS, mobile money, and bank feeds matched in the background).

Q: What do Deploy, Integrate, and Scale mean? A: Deploy gets the business visible and running on a real system. Integrate connects sales, stock, mobile money, bank feeds, and WhatsApp. Scale adds dashboards, spending controls, and reporting for owners and funders.
Q: Which industries does Nutekh work with? A: Retail, hospitality, healthcare, logistics, schools, and NGOs across Rwanda and the wider East Africa region.
Q: Where is Nutekh located? A: Nutekh is headquartered in Kigali, Rwanda, and works with clients across East Africa.
Q: What are Nutekh's opening hours? A: Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 18:00 Central Africa Time (CAT).
Q: How can I contact Nutekh? A: Email hello@nutekh.com or info@nutekh.com, call or WhatsApp +250 787 398 363, or use the contact form on nutekh.com.
Q: How much does the Launch package cost? A: Launch setup is RWF 700K to 1.8M (USD 500 to 1,300). Support starts from RWF 120K per month.
Q: How much does the Grow package cost? A: Grow setup is RWF 2M to 6M (USD 1,500 to 4,500). Support starts from RWF 350K per month.
Q: How much does the Scale package cost? A: Scale starts from RWF 8M (USD 5,700 and above). The final figure is quoted after we agree the scorecard and scope.

Q: What is included in Launch? A: Hresa or ImaliCloud go-live, a practical website with Google visibility, and WhatsApp lead flow. It is configured for East Africa's mixed mobile money and bank reality, with a typical go-live in about 7 days.

Q: What is included in Grow? A: WhatsApp automation and mobile money wired in, CRM and lead pipeline setup, one paid channel (Meta or Google), and reliable hand-offs between the tools you already use. Typical timeline is about 30 days.

Q: What is included in Scale? A: Dashboards your team will actually open, tighter spending controls, investor and sponsor checks, and reporting that lenders can follow. It suits multi-branch operations and businesses with outside backers.

Q: Which package should I choose? A: Launch is for new or offline businesses that need to get live fast. Grow is for businesses ready to connect WhatsApp, mobile money, and existing tools. Scale is for multi-branch operations or businesses with investors or lenders.
Q: How long does Launch take? A: About 7 days from paper to first real-world use is the typical figure. It is a planning estimate, not a guarantee.

Q: How long does Grow take? A: About 30 days to reach a connected rhythm is the typical figure. It depends on how many systems need to be joined and how quickly your team can join discovery and training.

Q: Can Nutekh handle custom scope or a different package? A: Yes. Anything outside the published packages is quoted after a free discovery call. A human will confirm scope, price, and timeline in writing.
Q: What is Hresa? A: Hresa is Nutekh's guest-flow product for busy venues. It covers QR ordering, readable kitchen tickets, and fast check-out, and it stays calm during rushes and event peaks.
Q: What is ImaliCloud? A: ImaliCloud puts cash, payroll, and stock in one cloud so finance and operations stop living in separate spreadsheets.

Q: What is Rainmaker? A: Rainmaker uses WhatsApp plus light AI to greet enquiries, filter tyre-kickers, follow up politely, and send serious buyers to your staff. Paid ads are added only after the free path already shows collected money.
Q: What is VUKA? A: VUKA is Nutekh's operations product for upscale stays, hotels, and property. It pairs Hresa guest flow with ImaliCloud books so owners stop relying on late-night spreadsheets.
Q: Does Nutekh connect mobile money? A: Yes. We connect MTN and Airtel mobile money (and similar rails) so taps, till sales, and bank deposits stay matched in the background.

Q: Does Nutekh integrate POS and bank feeds? A: Yes. POS or card-reader sales and bank deposits are matched in the background, which reduces double entries and gives owners one place to settle disputes.
Q: Can Nutekh automate WhatsApp? A: Yes. We set up WhatsApp greetings, FAQs, lead capture, qualification, and polite follow-ups, with warm prospects handed to a human. This is the Rainmaker track.

Q: Does Nutekh build websites and improve Google visibility? A: Yes. Presence work covers a clear, fast website plus verified Google and social profiles so buyers, guests, lenders, or partners trust the business on first look.
Q: Can I book a free call or audit? A: Yes. Nutekh offers a free 30-minute audit or planning call. The assistant can collect your details and arrange a hand-off to a human.

Q: What does Nutekh need to quote? A: Your business type, location, the tools you use today, which payments you accept, what is slowing you down, your rough budget range, and your target timeline. A discovery call turns that into a written scope.

Q: We already use other tools. Can you work with them? A: Yes. Grow is specifically about joining the apps you already pay for, including WhatsApp, mobile money, POS, and accounting exports, so income, stock, and follow-ups tell the same story.

Q: Do you train the team? A: Yes. Deliveries are phased with discovery workshops, supervised configuration, rehearsals, parallel runs where needed, and training that matches how teams actually work between power cuts and WhatsApp pings.
Q: Do you offer ongoing support? A: Yes. Launch retainers start from RWF 120K per month and Grow retainers from RWF 350K per month. Scale support is quoted with the scope.

Q: I am already a Nutekh client and need help. A: The assistant can answer questions about services, packages, and how things work. For account-specific issues, outages, or changes, it will pass the request to the support team and ask for your business name and a short description.
Q: Which languages does Nutekh support? A: Nutekh works in English, Kinyarwanda, French and Swahili, and the assistant replies in the language the customer uses, with English as the default.
Q: Do you work with businesses outside Kigali? A: Yes. Nutekh works across Rwanda and the wider East Africa region, with remote discovery and on-site work where the rollout needs it.

Q: How is our business data handled? A: Data handling is agreed during discovery before any system is connected. For a specific security or data-protection question, the assistant will arrange a call with the team.
Q: Is Nutekh a bank or mobile money provider? A: No. Nutekh connects the payment providers you already use. It does not replace your bank or mobile money operator and does not hold customer funds.
Q: Can I get contract terms, licensing, or refund details? A: Those are handled by a human. The assistant will collect your question and pass it to the team rather than guess.
Q: What is the next step? A: Share your business type, location, current tools, budget range, and timeline. The assistant will book a free 30-minute audit or pass your details to the Nutekh team.

Q: What services does Nutekh offer? A: Websites and Google presence; WhatsApp automation (greetings, FAQs, lead capture, qualification, follow-ups); business-process automation (invoicing, stock checks, approvals, reminders, payout alerts); payments and reconciliation (MTN/Airtel mobile money, POS/card readers, bank feeds); ImaliCloud (cash, payroll, inventory); Hresa (venue guest flow); VUKA (hotels and property); CRM and lead pipeline; and dashboards and reporting.
